capability_investigated:
WhisperProcessor feature extractor framing (fixed 30s mel window) and the
batch interface of frozen.asr_backend.generate — it accepts an (N, n_mels,
n_frames) StorageView with a list of N prompts and returns N results.
what_i_learned:
The extractor pads/truncates any input to exactly one 30s window, so the
stub silently dropped everything after 0:30 of each call (structural
deletion, length_ratio floored). generate() is batched over the leading
axis, so multiple 30s windows can be decoded in one call and concatenated.
hypothesis:
Split the waveform into consecutive non-overlapping 30s windows, extract mel
features per window, decode them all in one batched generate() call, and join
the per-window text in order. This recovers the deleted tail — the dominant
error axis for multi-minute 0715 calls — without touching decode params.
